questionSnapshot.question: In Mulan (1998), what is the name of the Hun leader?

notes: Read final stem/all options; checked full topic/category digests, cross-bank candidate stems and options, category, scope, giveaways and editorial difficulty. Pinned 1998 animation to exclude live-action Bori Khan. Even though other options suggest military authority, none is the unique leader named by the character entry. Chinese command and Emperor are separate from invading Huns.

verification.context: In Mulan (1998), what is the name of the Hun leader?

premise.reason: Shan Yu is the Hun leader.

sources.locator: Complete character entry identifies Shan-Yu as leader of Huns in Mulan.
